title: Believing Youth founded
summary: Zaydi scholar Mohammed Azzan founds Believing Youth in Saada to revive Zaydi identity through summer camps and study circles. The Houthi movement grows out of it.

title: First Saada war
summary: The government arrests hundreds of Houthi supporters and offers a reward for Hussein al-Houthi. Fighting begins in Saada.

title: Hussein al-Houthi killed
summary: The movement's founder is killed by government forces. Leadership passes to his younger brother Abdulmalik.

title: Operation Scorched Earth
summary: The army launches its largest offensive in Saada, the sixth round of the war.

title: Saudi Arabia enters the fighting
summary: Fighting spreads across the border for the first time. Saudi forces fight the Houthis and retake border areas the Houthis had seized.

title: Ceasefire ends sixth war
summary: Six rounds of war since 2004 end in a ceasefire, without a settlement. More than 250,000 people have been displaced.

title: Houthis take control of Saada
summary: While protests spread across Yemen, the Houthis take over Saada governorate and set up their own administration.

title: Saleh signs GCC initiative
summary: In Riyadh, Saleh agrees to hand power to his deputy, Abd Rabbuh Mansur Hadi, in return for immunity. The Houthis reject the deal.

title: Dammaj evacuated
summary: After a Houthi siege of the Salafi school of Dar al-Hadith, a government-brokered ceasefire ends with its leader and foreign students flown out.

title: Houthi delegate killed
summary: Ahmad Sharafeddin, a Houthi delegate to the National Dialogue, is shot dead in Sanaa, the second Houthi delegate killed in two months.

title: Amran falls
summary: The 310th Armoured Brigade is overrun. Its commander is killed.

title: Security forces fire on protesters
summary: Human Rights Watch counts nine dead over 7 and 9 September and finds no evidence the Houthi protesters were armed.

title: Houthis take Sanaa
summary: The Peace and National Partnership Agreement is signed the same night. The Houthis refuse its security annex.

title: UN sanctions Saleh and two Houthi commanders
summary: Designations under Security Council resolution 2140.

title: Hadi resigns
summary: Follows the Houthi seizure of the presidential palace. He later withdraws the resignation from Aden.

title: Coalition intervention begins
summary: A Saudi-led coalition launches airstrikes in support of Hadi's government.

title: Resolution 2216
summary: The Security Council demands Houthi withdrawal from seized areas and imposes an arms embargo on the movement's leaders.

title: Wedding strike near Mokha
summary: Airstrikes hit a wedding gathering. 131 people are reported killed. The UN Secretary-General condemns the attack. The coalition denies involvement.

title: Funeral hall strike, Sanaa
summary: Strikes on a crowded funeral hall kill more than 140 people, according to UN-cited health officials.

title: Saleh killed
summary: The Houthis kill their former ally days after he breaks with them.

title: School bus strike, Dahyan
summary: An airstrike on a bus in Saada governorate kills dozens of people. Officials say 40 of the dead are children.

title: Stockholm Agreement
summary: UN-brokered deal on Hodeidah, a prisoner exchange and Taiz.

title: Abqaiq and Khurais attack
summary: The Houthis claim strikes on Saudi oil facilities. The US blames Iran. In January 2020, UN monitors report that the Houthis did not carry out the attack.

title: Attack on Abu Dhabi
summary: A drone attack claimed by the Houthis hits the UAE capital. Three people are killed.

title: Nationwide truce
summary: A UN-brokered two-month truce begins. It is extended twice and expires in October, but large-scale fighting does not resume.

title: Galaxy Leader seized
summary: The Houthis hijack an Israeli-linked ship in the Red Sea and take its 25 crew hostage. It is the start of a campaign against commercial shipping.

title: US and UK strikes begin
summary: Strikes hit more than 60 Houthi targets in response to the shipping attacks.

title: UN and NGO staff detained
summary: The Houthis detain staff of UN agencies and aid groups. The UN calls for their release. Further detentions follow.

title: US–Houthi ceasefire
summary: An Oman-brokered understanding halts US strikes and Houthi attacks on US ships.

title: Houthi prime minister killed
summary: An Israeli strike in Sanaa kills Ahmed al-Rahawi, prime minister of the Houthi government, and several ministers.
